newsitem.title: USA: Kansas fed cattle trade $1 lower at $65, thin-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas fed cattle trade $1 lower at $65, thin-USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for an adequate market test, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed on 1,300 slaughter steers and 700 slaughter heifers , mostly hedged cattle.
Wk to date - 30,100 last week - 57,600 last year - 47,400
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1350 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1125 lbs 65.00.
For the week to date 30100 head confirmed including 28200 head or about 94 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
